notes.title: v1.0.5 - Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! We have another patch here. Sorry to everyone for the delay. We hope to continue offering our support. Many thanks to our dedicated players who reported all found bugs!

[b]Changelog - v1.0.5:[/b]

- Fixed wrong name in dialogs
- Fixed many scenes being black or wrongly played in the camp
- Fixed wrong death triggers in Chapter 6
- Fixed wrong end scene at end of Chapter 10
- Fixed optional chapters being wrongly replayable

notes.title: v1.0.4 - Bugfix and Features Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! We are here to announce the release of a new patch, fixing a few issues.

[b]Changelog - v1.0.4:[/b]

- Fixed transparent or invisible party members in menu
- Fixed main character appearing small in menu when navigating world map
- Fixed invisible Alain name in Bond Scene #2
- Ability to exit new game character creation (press X button)

notes.title: v1.0.2 - Bugfix and Features Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! We from Witz Games really appreciate your patience, your interest in the game, and especially your feedback regarding new features and bug reports.

We will be doing our best to implement anything we can to make the experience better. We hope that this new release will allow you to have even more fun with the game!

[b]Changelog - v1.0.2:[/b]

- Added quick start key for battles - 'Q' button
- Added menu during "Help" offering a recap of 5 areas of the game; "classes", "element", "element wheel", "controls" and "battle logic"
- Increased element wheel image size
- Fixed Earth Shrine random battle bug not returning back to world map
- Fixed post-battle Melarue early game end

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
We've fixed a few bugs and made some improvements. Check it out:

[list]
[*] Added a new difficulty setting: "Permanent Death Mode". Now, Classic and Story mode affect only enemies' difficulty, while the permanent death setting is separate.
[*] IMPORTANT: Added new "Settings" command in Camp. Now, you can change both difficulty settings in-game!
[*] Fixed remaining debug party changes throughout the game
[/list]
Feel free to report any bug you find and join [url=https://discord.com/invite/rSXexbQ4Uq]Discord[/url] so that we can talk about our new projects!

notes.title: General Updates
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41936610/6f40dcc6e473ba0c7d84095b60623e5734745342.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

It's been a while since our last Crystal Tales update devlog, but we assure you that the project is still going strong! We have been dedicated to improving the game and bringing it to you as soon as possible.

We are currently implementing and fine-tuning the game's scenes, each with the potential for multiple outcomes depending on the progress of the story. Character deaths, for example, play a crucial role in shaping the game's narrative and relationships in the Classic game mode.

In addition, we have plans for in-game achievements. Players will have the opportunity to reach the maximum relationship level with all the characters without the need to date each one. You can unlock all the achievements in a single playthrough!

With slightly more complex gameplay, we are working on providing clear guidance to the players on what they need to do and how battles work. We've also fixed issues with the camera that exhibited abnormal behavior.

Last but not least, the game trailer is almost finished and will be released soon!

Wishlist Crystal Tales on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829850/Crystal_Tales_Tactics_Echoes_of_the_Libertas_War/?l=portuguese]Steam[/url] and join our [url=https://discordapp.com/channels/1121553190060568728/1121811001990459513]Discord channel[/url] to stay updated with everything.

notes.title: Demo d5.0.0 is now available!
notes.notes:
Good afternoon, everybody! 

We would like to announce the new demo version of Crystal Tales Tactics. We have several new updates, and we can't wait for you to see all the content we have prepared for you. We're doing our best to fix bugs and polish the system in any way we can!

Among the changes:
[list][*] New sprites and busts for characters you didn't have before!
[*] Camp is now a menu interface instead of an explorable map, aiming for better accessibility of information
[*] Two new maps
[*] A new tutorial (optional) to better explain the functions and mechanics of the game
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the demo and if you haven't wishlisted the game, do it right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829850/Crystal_Tales_Tactics_Echoes_of_the_Libertas_War/

Thank you all for your support.

notes.title: Introducing the characters!
notes.notes:

Do you already know all the Crystal Tales characters?
